description: This file defines the LeaveType entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping it to the 'ohrm_leave_type' database table using Doctrine ORM. It includes properties such as ID, name, flags for whether it is situational or deleted, and relationships to operational country and leave entitlements.

classes.name: LeaveType
classes.description: Entity class representing a leave type in the HRM system, with properties for ID, name, status flags, related operational country, and leave entitlements.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the leave type.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the leave type.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the leave type.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the leave type.

methods.name: isSituational
methods.description: Checks if the leave type is considered situational.

methods.name: setSituational
methods.description: Sets whether the leave type is situational.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the leave type has been marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Sets the deletion status of the leave type.

methods.name: getOperationalCountry
methods.description: Gets the operational country associated with this leave type.

methods.name: setOperationalCountry
methods.description: Sets the operational country related to this leave type.
